Evidence/CLM-009
Evidence record

The official 2026 exchange and remittance roster is countable; current operation is a separate question

What does this evidence establish?

The official 2026 roster of exchange and remittance providers issued by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) lists 98 exchange companies, 225 individual exchange establishments and 106 remittance agents. These are roster entries counted by the roster's own classes: the three class totals are not a count of unique providers, nor a verified count of providers operating now. Because the roster does not state its issue date, CBY-Aden's 2026 decisions suspending, withdrawing or closing named entities (dated January to September 2026) are matched with the roster entity by entity in both directions: a decision may or may not already be reflected in it.

What does it measure?

The number of entries in each of the three classes of the 2026 exchange and remittance roster of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden).

Who or what does it apply to?

Source-listed exchange companies, individual exchange establishments and remittance agents; rows are counted separately by the three classes used in the official roster.

When was it measured or observed?

The official 2026 roster (issue date not stated); 2026 enforcement decisions are separate evidence.

How current is it?

The counts refer to the official 2026 annual roster, whose issue date is not stated. Decisions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated January to September 2026 may change the licence or operating status of named entities; they are separate evidence and are not applied to these counts.

What this evidence does not establish

Adding the three classes does not give a count of unique providers, because no rule for identifying the same entity across classes has been applied. Inclusion in the annual roster is not proof of current operation, branch activity or service availability, including for entities named in 2026 enforcement decisions.

Method and verification detailAdditional detail for reproducing or challenging the reading without changing the evidence meaning.

How was it produced?

Entries were counted from the official 11-page roster of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) by reading the document visually, using its own class headings and serial numbering; the numbering in the three classes ends at 98, 225 and 106.

When does this record change?

These counts are updated when the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) publishes a revised or newer annual roster. A statement about current operating status requires official status decisions to be matched to named entities first.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?
